schema_version: 2.1.0
name: skill-manager
version: 1.1.0
description: >-
  Full CRUD lifecycle management for reactive skills - CREATE UPDATE DELETE
  MIGRATE_LEGACY and MIGRATE_REACTIVE with pre-COMMIT approval best-effort
  rollback and manifest snapshot projection
initial_state: INIT
context_keys:
  - skill_name
  - operation
  - skill_config
  - migrate_mode
  - source_version
  - target_version
states:
  INIT:
    description: 'Bootloader: Verify reactive runtime environment'
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: READY
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: SETUP_RUNTIME
  SETUP_RUNTIME:
    description: Auto-configure harness MCP server
    prompt_template: states/setup_runtime.md
    tools:
      - run_command
    transitions:
      SETUP_COMPLETE:
        target: READY
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      SETUP_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0
  READY:
    prompt_template: states/ready.md
    transitions:
      USER_INVOKED:
        target: PARSING
        guard: context.skill_name != null
  PARSING:
    prompt_template: states/parsing.md
    transitions:
      PARSED:
        target: DETECTING
        guard: >-
          ["CREATE","UPDATE","DELETE","MIGRATE_LEGACY","MIGRATE_REACTIVE"].includes(context.operation)
      ERROR:
        target: ERROR
        guard: >-
          !["CREATE","UPDATE","DELETE","MIGRATE_LEGACY","MIGRATE_REACTIVE"].includes(context.operation)
  DETECTING:
    prompt_template: states/detecting.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
    transitions:
      NOT_EXISTS_CREATE:
        target: PLANNING
        guard: context.operation === "CREATE"
      EXISTS_CREATE:
        target: ERROR
        guard: context.operation === "CREATE"
      EXISTS_UPDATE_DELETE:
        target: PLANNING
        guard: '["UPDATE","DELETE"].includes(context.operation)'
      NOT_EXISTS_UPDATE_DELETE:
        target: ERROR
        guard: '["UPDATE","DELETE"].includes(context.operation)'
      IS_LEGACY:
        target: BACKING_UP_MIGRATE
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_LEGACY"
      IS_NOT_LEGACY:
        target: ERROR
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_LEGACY"
      IS_V1_REACTIVE:
        target: BACKING_UP_MIGRATE
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_REACTIVE"
      NOT_V1_REACTIVE:
        target: ERROR
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_REACTIVE"
  PLANNING:
    prompt_template: states/planning.md
    transitions:
      PLAN_READY:
        target: APPROVING
  APPROVING:
    prompt_template: states/approving.md
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: EXECUTING
      USER_REJECTED:
        target: ERROR
  EXECUTING:
    prompt_template: states/executing.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - replace_file_content
      - run_command
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      EXECUTED:
        target: VERIFYING
  VERIFYING:
    prompt_template: states/verifying.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - run_command
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      VERIFIED_OK:
        target: PROJECTING
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      VERIFIED_FAIL:
        target: ROLLING_BACK
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0
  ROLLING_BACK:
    prompt_template: states/rolling_back.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      ROLLED_BACK:
        target: ERROR
      ROLLBACK_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
  BACKING_UP_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/backing_up_migrate.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      BACKED_UP_LEGACY:
        target: INFERRING_LEGACY
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_LEGACY"
      BACKED_UP_REACTIVE:
        target: INSPECTING_REACTIVE
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_REACTIVE"
  INFERRING_LEGACY:
    prompt_template: states/inferring_legacy.md
    transitions:
      INFERRED:
        target: PLANNING_MIGRATE
        guard: payload.confidence >= 0.5
      LOW_CONFIDENCE:
        target: GRILLING_MIGRATE
        guard: payload.confidence < 0.5
  GRILLING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/grilling_migrate.md
    transitions:
      GRILL_COMPLETE:
        target: PLANNING_MIGRATE
  INSPECTING_REACTIVE:
    prompt_template: states/inspecting_reactive.md
    transitions:
      INSPECTED:
        target: PLANNING_MIGRATE
  PLANNING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/planning_migrate.md
    transitions:
      PLAN_READY:
        target: APPROVING_MIGRATE
  APPROVING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/approving_migrate.md
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: EXECUTING_MIGRATE
      USER_REJECTED:
        target: RESTORING_MIGRATE
  EXECUTING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/executing_migrate.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - replace_file_content
      - run_command
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      EXECUTED:
        target: VERIFYING_MIGRATE
  VERIFYING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/verifying_migrate.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - run_command
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      VERIFIED_OK:
        target: PROJECTING
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      VERIFIED_FAIL:
        target: RESTORING_MIGRATE
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0
  RESTORING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/restoring_migrate.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      RESTORED:
        target: ERROR
      RESTORE_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
  PROJECTING:
    prompt_template: states/projecting.md
    transitions:
      PROJECTED:
        target: SUCCESS
  SUCCESS:
    prompt_template: states/success.md
  ERROR:
    prompt_template: states/error.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file

  - template: templates/inventory.json.hbs
